title: RunManifest
description: On-disk manifest for a persisted Symposium session under `runs/<session_id>/` (§7.1, §7.2). The manifest is the index a reader consults first: it identifies the implementation that produced the directory, the canonical artifact path, and any sibling files (config snapshot, transcript journal, observability log). The artifact (`artifact.schema.json`) remains the authoritative session output (§5.10); the manifest is a thin metadata layer for directory validation, partial-state recovery, and forward-compat with additional sibling files. `status` distinguishes in-progress sessions (writable, missing `artifact.json`) from complete sessions (read-only, `artifact.json` present). `session_id` MUST match `config.session_id` and `artifact.session_id`; `transcript_digest` MUST equal the digest computed over the canonical_transcript at completion. The manifest is written atomically per §7.4 once the session terminates; for in-progress sessions a `status = in_progress` manifest MAY exist as a journal sidecar.

schema_version.description: SemVer of the run_manifest schema this instance validates against (§5.1). Pass 6 ships `1.0.0`.

manifest_version.description: SemVer of the on-disk layout convention. Distinct from `schema_version` so the manifest schema and the layout can evolve independently. Pass 6 ships `1.0.0`.

session_id.description: Session identifier; MUST equal `config.session_id` and (when `status = complete` or `status = terminated`) `artifact.session_id`. Constrained to a cross-filesystem-safe charset to roundtrip on POSIX, Windows, and case-insensitive filesystems (§7.1).

status.description: Lifecycle state of the on-disk directory. CLOSED enum. `in_progress` — session is still running; `artifact.json` MAY be absent and `journal_path` SHOULD be present. `complete` — session ended with a synthesis outcome; `artifact.json` MUST be present. `terminated` — session ended with a termination_artifact outcome; `artifact.json` MUST be present. `crashed` — session never reached `persist`; a reader MUST NOT silently re-run, and MUST treat the journal as best-effort partial state (§7.3).

producer.description: Identifier and version of the implementation that wrote the directory. Used by readers for compatibility decisions and by audits to trace artifact provenance. The `name` is a free string (e.g. an OSS implementation name); the `version` is SemVer. Neither field is a vendor identifier in the rule-N4 sense (it identifies the Symposium implementation, not a model vendor).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 datetime when the manifest was first written (typically equal to `artifact.started_at`).

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 datetime when the manifest was last modified. Optional for `status = complete` / `terminated` (where the manifest is written once and not modified); REQUIRED for `status = in_progress` / `crashed` so a reader can detect staleness.

artifact_path.description: Relative path (within the run directory) to the canonical artifact JSON file (typically `artifact.json`). REQUIRED for every status; readers consult the manifest BEFORE opening the artifact, so the path is named here even when the file is absent (`status = in_progress` / `crashed`).

config_path.description: Relative path to the resolved Config snapshot (typically `config.json`). The Config is a copy of `artifact.config` extracted for indexability — a reader can inspect the configuration without parsing the full artifact.

journal_path.description: Optional relative path to the transcript journal (a per-turn append-only log, typically `transcript.jsonl`). PRESENT when `status = in_progress` or `status = crashed`; OPTIONAL when `status = complete` / `terminated` (the journal MAY be retained for debugging but the artifact is authoritative). The journal format is implementation-defined; readers MUST NOT rely on it as a source of truth (§7.3).

observability_log_path.description: Optional relative path to a per-session observability log (e.g. `observability.jsonl`). Reserved for v1+ structured observability streams (§7.10); MVP implementations MAY omit. Format is implementation-defined.

transcript_digest.description: SHA-256 hex digest (lowercase, 64 chars) computed over the JCS-canonicalized canonical_transcript at session end (§7.7). REQUIRED when `status = complete` / `terminated`; FORBIDDEN when `status = in_progress` / `crashed` (the transcript is not yet final). When present, MUST equal `artifact.transcript_digest` and (for terminate paths) `termination_artifact.transcript_digest`.

outcome_kind.description: Mirror of `artifact.outcome.kind` for fast indexability. REQUIRED when `status = complete` (value `synthesis`) or `status = terminated` (value `termination`); FORBIDDEN otherwise.

notes.description: Free-text human-readable notes (operator comments, deployment context, etc.). Schema-opaque. MUST NOT contain credential material (§8.9).
